_note: USD per 1M tokens, used by usage_accounting.py for cost estimates. Verified against the OpenRouter model lists on retrieved_at: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (pricing.prompt, pricing.input_cache_read, pricing.completion are USD per token; multiplied by 1e6 here) and GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/embeddings/models for the embedding model. The 2026-09-23 billed amounts in OpenRouter analytics reproduce to the cent with these gpt-5.4-mini rates. Models whose id ends in ':free' cost 0 and need no entry. A model missing here gets no estimate. The longest matching id prefix wins, so a dated id such as openai/gpt-5.4-mini-20260317 is priced as openai/gpt-5.4-mini, not as openai/gpt-5.4.
replaced: Lab 6.2 APPROX_PRICE_PER_MTOK (gpt-5.4-mini 0.2 input / 0.8 output), which understated input 3.75x and output 5.6x
long_context_note: gpt-5.4 long-prompt tier verified 2026-10-04 (GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/openai/gpt-5.4/endpoints, pricing.overrides min_prompt_tokens 272000). It reproduces the provider-reported cost of the two >272K-token calls in the 7.1 GT run to the tenth of a cent. gpt-5.4-mini has no tier.
jev_note: typesafe/jev-1.13 verified 2026-10-04 (GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/typesafe/jev-1.13/endpoints): $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free, no caching, 32,000-token context. Served through POST /api/alpha/decisions, which reports usage.cost per call.
